title: Sparkly train
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Sparkles around the train -->
  <g fill="#FFF3A0">
    <circle cx="18" cy="30" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="25" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="55" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="58" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="15" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="70" r="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="25" cy="72" r="1.8"/>
    <!-- Star sparkles -->
    <path d="M30 18 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5z"/>
    <path d="M72 38 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5z"/>
    <path d="M20 45 l1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Track / rail -->
  <rect x="8" y="82" width="84" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8B7355"/>
  <rect x="8" y="80" width="84" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#A89070"/>

  <!-- Train body - main cab -->
  <rect x="38" y="52" width="32" height="28" rx="4" fill="#E84C3D"/>
  <rect x="38" y="52" width="32" height="8" rx="4" fill="#F06A5C"/>

  <!-- Cab roof -->
  <rect x="36" y="47" width="36" height="8" rx="4" fill="#CC3B2D"/>
  <rect x="36" y="47" width="36" height="3" rx="3" fill="#E84C3D"/>

  <!-- Chimney -->
  <rect x="60" y="38" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill="#5D4E8C"/>
  <rect x="58" y="36" width="12" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#7B6BAE"/>

  <!-- Smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="30" r="4" fill="#B8A9E8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="23" r="5" fill="#C8BBF0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="20" r="3.5" fill="#D5CAF5" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Cab window -->
  <rect x="44" y="60" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <rect x="44" y="60" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE99A"/>

  <!-- Cab door -->
  <rect x="58" y="62" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#CC3B2D"/>
  <circle cx="64.5" cy="68" r="1" fill="#FFD966"/>

  <!-- Boiler / front engine -->
  <rect x="14" y="62" width="26" height="18" rx="4" fill="#3D9B8F"/>
  <rect x="14" y="62" width="26" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5CBDB0"/>

  <!-- Boiler front face -->
  <circle cx="16" cy="71" r="9" fill="#2E7D74"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="71" r="6" fill="#3D9B8F"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="71" r="3" fill="#FFD966"/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <!-- Big drive wheel -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="82" r="8" fill="#4A4A6A"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="82" r="5" fill="#6B6B9A"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="82" r="2" fill="#FFD966"/>

  <!-- Small front wheel -->
  <circle cx="12" cy="82" r="5" fill="#4A4A6A"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="82" r="3" fill="#6B6B9A"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="82" r="1.2" fill="#FFD966"/>

  <!-- Big rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="82" r="7" fill="#4A4A6A"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="82" r="4.5" fill="#6B6B9A"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="82" r="1.8" fill="#FFD966"/>

  <!-- Coupling rod -->
  <rect x="20" y="80" width="42" height="2.5" rx="1.2" fill="#FFD966"/>

  <!-- Front headlight -->
  <circle cx="14" cy="64" r="3" fill="#FFF3A0"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="64" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Extra tiny sparkles near train -->
  <g fill="#FFF3A0">
    <circle cx="90" cy="40" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="42" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="78" r="1.2"/>
  </g>
</svg>
